name: rosetta-tau-function
code:
use default

tau(value: int) -> int is
    let divisors mut = 0
    let candidate mut = 1

    while candidate * candidate <= value do
        if value % candidate == 0 then
            divisors = divisors + 2

            if candidate * candidate == value then
                divisors = divisors - 1
            fi
        fi

        candidate = candidate + 1
    od

    divisors
si

write_line("the number of divisors of 1 to 100:")

for row in 0..10 do
    let cells = (row * 10 + 1::row * 10 + 10) |> map(n => "{tau(n),4}")

    write_line(cells |> join(""))
od
